svg.data-weight-note: 24.8 lb (11.25 kg) with two power supplies and five fan modules installed (Table 9)
svg.data-depth-note: 20.48 in (52.02 cm) excluding the fan and power supply handles (Table 9)
svg.data-sfp28-speeds: 25, 10 or 1 GbE, set a quad at a time; the default is 10 GbE
svg.data-qsfp28-speeds: 100 or 40 GbE; channelizes to 4 x 25, 4 x 10 or 2 x 50 GbE
svg.data-power-macsec-note: 291 W typical and 460 W maximum with MACsec (Table 30)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 7.5 A at 100 VAC or 3 A at 240 VAC
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -43.2 to -69 VDC, 16 A
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing and fully redundant; both should be installed
svg.data-fans: five fan modules, 4+1; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) normal operation
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1829 m (6000 ft)
svg.data-macsec: IEEE 802.1AE MACsec AES-256 on all ports
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 4 switches (Junos 23.1R1); any non-channelized QSFP28 port (48 to 55) can be a virtual chassis port
svg.data-timing: PPS OUT and 10M OUT measurement ports (DIN 1.0/2.3, TTL 5 V); PTP supported
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25 GbE, 10 GbE or 1 GbE with MACsec
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100 GbE or 40 GbE with MACsec; channelizes to 4 x 25 GbE, 4 x 10 GbE or 2 x 50 GbE (guide Table 5)
svg.data-oob: two RJ-45 management ports (C0 and C1) with link and status lamps
